It demands careful selection of functional, basis, and ECP to match the paper's level of theory, and understanding of molecular symmetry and mode assignment, though no novel algorithmic derivation is needed.
rationale.execution: The pipeline is essentially a single DFT calculation: build input, run, parse output, and write JSON. It involves 2–3 sequential steps (e.g., geometry optimization then frequency analysis) and standard I/O, with no complex orchestration or fragile tooling beyond setting up a DFT code (ORCA/NWChem/CP2K).
